label: Конь
description: Twelve-mission case drill for конь (horse, steed) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form конь ends in a soft sign and takes no added ending as the subject. As the doer of стоит, it stands in the nominative, the naming form.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The soft stem replaces -ь with -я, giving коня. The phrase нет of absence governs the genitive, and the soft stem takes -я rather than the hard -а.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The -ь softens into the dative ending -ю, producing коню. The preposition к, marking motion toward, governs the dative, and the soft stem gives -ю in place of -у.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. Because конь is animate, its accusative copies the genitive form коня. It serves as the direct object of оседлал, and animacy is what selects the genitive-shaped ending.

Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The soft, end-stressed stem takes -ём, giving конём. The verb гордиться governs the instrumental, and the stress on the ending forces ё rather than the unstressed е.

missions.phrase: В сказке речь идёт о коне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The -ь is replaced by the prepositional ending -е, giving коне. The preposition о, marking the topic, governs the prepositional, where soft masculine nouns take -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The soft stem forms the plural in -и, so конь becomes кони. As the subjects of пасутся, they appear in the nominative plural, the listing form.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The soft stem takes the genitive plural ending -ей, giving коней. The quantity word много governs the genitive, and the soft stem selects -ей rather than -ов.

Strategic focus: Dative plural. The dative plural ending -ям attaches to the soft stem, giving коням. The dative marks the recipients to whom the hay is given, and the soft stem gives -ям rather than -ам.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. Because конь is animate, the accusative plural copies the genitive plural коней. They serve as the direct objects of запрягли, and animacy forces the genitive-shaped plural ending.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The instrumental plural ending -ями attaches to the soft stem, giving конями. The instrumental names what the field is covered with, and the soft stem selects -ями over -ами.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The prepositional plural ending -ях attaches to the soft stem, giving конях. The preposition на, marking the means of travel here, governs the prepositional, and the soft stem gives -ях rather than -ах.
